w:r.w:t: White Sox — Kid Zone Refresh Proposal

This proposal presents a comprehensive scope of work to reimagine the White Sox kid zone, with the 300 level prioritized for delivery in the upcoming season. We build experiences that drive repeat visitation, measurable engagement, and sponsor value. Our approach is outcome focused; we deliver measurable guest behavior change, not just installations.
• Full scope solution, priced to reflect the true cost of ownership for a build that addresses the full set of goals, including design, fabrication, systems, and installation.

• Phased, a la carte path. If you choose an a la carte approach, we will work with you during the design process to identify priorities, sequence deliveries by season, and produce a phased spend plan that shows the operational and guest impact of each choice. We will not dictate priorities, we will collaborate to find the mix that meets your goals and budget.

Key priorities addressed in this proposal: modernize the kid zone for ages 0 to 15, replace single-use high-footprint attractions with modular, reconfigurable systems, integrate interactive technology such as AR and leaderboards, preserve brand longevity without relying on player imagery, and deliver on an accelerated schedule for the next season.
Create an immersive, durable kid zone that becomes a recurring destination for families and a measurable marketing asset for the club and partners.
• Repeatable novelty, not gimmick. Modular systems that can be reprogrammed and re-themed seasonally.
• Outcome measurement. Leaderboards, opt-in social features, and analytics provide measurable KPIs.
• Sponsor-ready design. Durable sponsor touch points that are easy to refresh.
• Operational robustness. Materials and systems specified to withstand heavy daily use and minimize downtime.
How this responds to your goals
• Replace oversized single-use elements with modular centerpiece and skill stations to increase throughput and engagement per square foot.
• AR and leaderboard features create social and repeat plays.
• Phased delivery enables a prototype on the 300 level, then scaling to the 400 and 500 levels.
Concept, design, and prototype delivery for the 300 level

Schematic and design development, guest journey maps, experience scripts, design documentation for the modular centerpiece, skill stations, dugout exhibit, kids club refresh, and Xfinity room activations. AR content design and one season of tuning. Fabrication, systems integration, installation, commissioning, and QA documentation.
Scaled rollouts and a la carte modules
Phased deployment packages, sponsor packaging, and scaled versions of the 300 level modules for subsequent seasons. Includes lessons learned and optimization from the prototype.

Bridgewater: design, fabrication, system integration, installation, warranty support for the first season, and a phase plan for scaling. White Sox: provide architectural plans, site access windows, and timely milestone approvals.
Strategy deck with tiered investment options, detailed construction drawings, submittals, vendor coordination packages, factory and shop reports, QA sign-offs, and commissioning documentation.

• Installation is local and non-union unless you advise otherwise. Installation labor is priced as local, no travel or per diem. Client to confirm site access milestones for installation and acceptance.
Contract executed and design retainer received
Strategy deck and tiered options delivered (two weeks after retainer)
Substantial completion and ready for opening
Demo and removal of race attraction
Demolition, selective removal, disposal of existing racing attraction, and minor patching to adjacent finishes. Includes hazardous screening, crating, and coordination with venue operations.

Design and fabrication of a modular, reconfigurable centerpiece exhibit that supports multiple game modes and sponsor overlays. Includes structural framing, finishes, and integration points for tech and signage.
Custom AR content, integration with on-site displays, and back-end scoring/leaderboard
integration. Includes one season of tuning and QA.
Custom theatrical and accent lighting, programmable controllers, and comprehensive graphic wraps for walls and exhibits. Includes photometric review and installation.
AV hardware, mounting, control systems, and integration with existing scoreboard and network for leaderboards and shared displays. Includes basic commissioning.
Replace or upgrade flooring in high-traffic activity zones including impact padding where needed, adhesives, and finishing. Includes subfloor prep.
Large-format scenic fabrication for themed walls, sculptural elements, and durable photo walls. Includes finish work and mounting hardware.
Moveable kiosks, benches, trophy/display pedestals, and small-scale interactive kiosks. Includes basic on-site assembly.
New power distribution, dedicated circuits for interactive elements, and additional data drops for AV and kiosks. Includes testing and labeling.
Themed signage, donor/sponsor panels, and directional wayfinding to integrate with new zones. Includes installation.
Custom redemption counter, shelving, and secure prize storage. Includes finishes and mounting to existing conditions.
Wall graphics, branded elements, and rotating prize display concepts for ongoing refresh. Includes material and installation.
Modular displays and AV upgrades to support activations, streaming, and point-of-view screens for events.
Three durable photo installations, foundations, mounting, and basic lighting to be used seasonally.
Portable skill stations, nets, targets, and soft-surface matting for infield play areas. Includes small equipment and storage carts.
Small-scale dugout interpretation, helmet/bat interactives, and kid-sized hands-on elements. Includes mounts and protective finishes.
On-site installation labor, on-site coordination, daily briefings, and close-out.
Phased mobilization to minimize venue dark time.
Site lifts, scaffolds, carts, small tools, and rigging hardware suited to access constraints.
Local trucking, crating, and scheduled deliveries for a local delivery.

Experience design scope including concept refinement, guest journey mapping, interaction design, and sponsor integration planning. This line supports creative development and design deliverables that translate the strategy into buildable packages.

Project management and related activities including schedule and stakeholder coordination, submittals and RFIs, vendor integration, quality control, risk and change tracking, documentation, and design-to-fabrication handoffs with standing status meetings.

We will define measurable success metrics during design sign-off. Recommended initial KPIs include repeat visit rate for households with children, average session time in the kid zone, opt-ins for leaderboard/social features, and sponsor impressions per game day. Bridgewater will provide baseline expectations tied to your chosen tier.

Standard workmanship and materials warranty for 12 months from handover, plus a season of software tuning and one post-opening maintenance window. Extended maintenance contracts are available a la carte.

We provide integrated design, fabrication, and interactive media capabilities so you have a single accountable partner for outcome, schedule, and quality. Our process reduces administrative overhead and gets more of your budget into guest-facing value. We are experienced and collaborative, and we work with your team to deliver measurable results.
1) Confirm which path you prefer: full scope or phased a la carte.
2) Confirm contract execution and payment of the design retainer to mobilize design work.
3) Request an export using the Bridgewater Proposal Template and we will prepare a docx with the ROM as an appendix.
